scope: First shot, 84 frames; mask-only comparison, no render or production change.
findings: Sampled compositor cleanup removed zero pixels: observed gaps predate that cleanup.
720p and 768p text-prompt masks show small boundary differences, without a clear visual win over 480p.
Fresh moving-frame torso point produced the most promising whole-person coverage in reviewed frames.
Initial-frame anchor produced a tiny partial mask and 15 empty frames; an anchor name is not proof it selected the torso.
Arm-only point tracked a body part rather than a full person; unsuitable as standalone person mask.
3px and 7px closing made small changes and did not establish a solution.
limitations: No hand-labelled ground truth; added mask area is not an accuracy score.
Reviewed four moving frames and whole-shot coverage counts; not a cross-clip quality validation.
No global thresholds or production defaults changed.
recommendation: Prefer a well-placed whole-person recovery prompt with quality checks over globally raising resolution or blindly expanding masks.
